nodes.label:
New Message
to Send
nodes.title: New Message to Send
nodes.info: Any outgoing message a mentor needs to send to families or mentors.

nodes.label:
Needs Action Within
the Hour?
nodes.title: Needs Action Within the Hour?
nodes.info: A same-day room change or a running-late notice both count as urgent.

nodes.label:
Send via Group
Messaging App
nodes.title: Send via Group Messaging App
nodes.info: Reaches families checking their phones in real time. Not meant to be a permanent record -- do not send anything here that someone will need to find again in three weeks.

nodes.label:
Needs a Searchable
Written Record?
nodes.title: Needs a Searchable Written Record?
nodes.info: A schedule change, a newsletter, or anything a family might need to reference weeks later.

nodes.label: Send via Email
nodes.title: Send via Email
nodes.info: Easily searched later; appropriate for anything semi-official. The slower channel, which is exactly why it is the wrong one for an urgent message.

nodes.label:
Either Channel
Works
nodes.title: Either Channel Works
nodes.info: For a low-stakes, non-urgent note, mentor judgment and family preference can decide.
